title: API registry audit logging may not capture all API access methods
description: The verification pattern 'GET.*/apis/jentic-test' found zero matches in control plane logs, despite the agent successfully locating and retrieving the test API details. This suggests either the agent used an alternative access method not captured by the audit pattern, or the logging is incomplete.
symptoms: Agent narration claims successful API discovery and retrieval
Verification found zero audit log matches for expected API access pattern
Discrepancy between agent's reported success and audit trail
root_cause_hint: The verification pattern may be too narrow (e.g., only matching GET requests to /apis/ endpoints), or the harness may not be logging all API access methods (e.g., CLI commands that internally call APIs). Alternatively, the test API may be accessed via a different endpoint path than expected.
evidence: Observation: '[bug] task=find-credential | Agent narration claims Goal 3 complete and reports finding test API at jentic-test/test-api/1.0.0 with endpoint GET http://test-api:8080/get. However, verification found zero matches for pattern \'GET.*/apis/jentic-test\' in control plane logs.'
